text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Now then—allow me to style you 
wonderfully.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
A four-leaf clover... a symbol of 
happiness. Such a kind present— I couldn't 
possibly... just accept it without giving 
anything back.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If you were the centerpiece... I'd make it 
a petite bouquet— and perhaps accent it 
with little white flowers.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
To match this little glass vial... let's 
tie a lace ribbon around it―― Hehe, let's 
make you look even prettier.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
And then... I'll return it, along with all 
my feelings of gratitude.
